newsitem.title: USA: ADP, CheckFree modify joint venture.
newsitem.headline: ADP, CheckFree modify joint venture.

text.p: Automatic Data Processing Inc said Tuesday that it and CheckFree Corp modified terms of their commercial electronic banking and bill payment venture, ECPartners.

Under the new agreement, which became effective on July 1, ADP said it will continue to sell Business Express/PC, a commercial electronic banking product, to financial institutions, while CheckFree will provide bill payment processing services for those customers.
All assets and about 100 employees of the existing joint operation will move to ADP.
In turn, ADP said CheckFree will provide it with bill payment processing services and retain its rights to the commercial electronic bill payment technology.
ADP said the changes will enable it to focus on its Electronic Services Division, while CheckFree said the new agreement will allow it to pursue other opportunities.
ADP provides computerized transaction processing, data communications, software and information services. CheckFree provides electronic commerce services.
